views.name: filtered_cast_pairs
views.body_sql: SELECT film.film_id, actor.actor_id, actor.first_name || ' ' || actor.last_name AS actor_name FROM film JOIN film_actor ON film.film_id = film_actor.film_id JOIN actor ON film_actor.actor_id = actor.actor_id
views.description: Joins film metadata with cast information to produce a denormalized relation of actor-film associations, restricted to films matching specific language, genre, rating, runtime, and year criteria.

views.name: actor_appearance_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT actor_id, actor_name, COUNT(film_id) AS film_count
FROM filtered_cast_pairs
GROUP BY actor_id, actor_name
views.description: Groups the filtered actor-film associations by actor to calculate the total number of qualifying films each actor has starred in.
